name: amber-v2-pages
description: Standalone SSR sandbox for v2 static page designs, mirroring the amber-user-website build pipeline.

scripts.dev: run-s dev:build && cross-env LOCAL_PORT=3005 DEVICE=desktop nodemon ./public/server
scripts.build:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=production DEVICE=desktop node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/rspack build --config ./webpack/server.config.ts
scripts.build:client: cross-env NODE_ENV=production DEVICE=desktop node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/rspack build --config ./webpack/client.config.ts
scripts.dev:build:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DEVICE=desktop LOCAL_PORT=3005 node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/rspack build --config ./webpack/server.config.ts
scripts.dev:build:client: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DEVICE=desktop LOCAL_PORT=3005 node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/rspack build --config ./webpack/client.config.ts

//resolutions: @types/react-router-config pulls its own nested @types/react. Two copies in the tree make every library class component (Helmet, BrowserRouter, StaticRouter) fail with TS2786 'cannot be used as a JSX component'. Pin to one copy.
//browserslist: Must match amber-user-website exactly. Autoprefixer reads this; without it the default query emits fewer -webkit- prefixes and the ported pages lose vendor-prefixed transform/transition/flex declarations.
